species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 58°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 14–42 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 70 ft, cold below.
West wind at 20 mph pushes bait onto the east shore: try the wind-blown banks.
